set.body: Deliver three scientific-core increments on the current temporal-processing baseline: explicit publication of retained completed runs after destination conflicts; bounded phase1/phase2 fieldmap-family interpretation and coherent views; generated query agreement and measured PostgreSQL scale. Child tasks carry implementation scope, dependencies and acceptance proof. Preserve historical identities, current authority and ordinary atomic acceptance. Existing working-tree changes are the supplied baseline: do not revert, clean or silently replace them. No institutional identity, remote scheduler, generic pipeline framework or blanket BIDS-conformance claim. Close this epic only after the final integrated evidence task passes. See docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md; the reported 328-test baseline is historical evidence, not a fresh run.
set.title: Night tranche: recoverable publication, fieldmap families, and query qualification
